text:
claire: Quick sync — onboarding zeta-2.6b weights. I pushed a manifest but the S3 prefix doesn't match the HF origin. Can someone confirm the preferred canonical path? I uploaded a draft to s3://redwood-temp/zeta/2.6b/weights/sha256:abc123 but ingest job expects canonical s3://models.redwood.com/hf/zeta-2.6b/weights/

ben: We standardize on s3://models.redwood.com/hf/<model>/<version>/weights/. HF origin should be noted in the manifest as "origin": "hf" so registry routing knows it's mirrored.

alice: pinging ops — @leo do we have presign policy for that bucket for onboarding workflows? Need a shorter TTL for staging mirrors.

leo: ops here — we can issue presigned URLs with 24h TTL for ingest jobs. Recommend storing both the weights and a sha256 digest file next to the shard (shard-0002.sha256) so the ingest verifier is happy. Also request putting tokenizer.json at s3://models.redwood.com/hf/zeta-2.6b/tokenizer.json (same prefix).

claire: Heads up — local tokenizer tests show a pad token mismatch for zeta. Model tokens use 50256 as pad in runtime but tokenizer.json currently has "pad_token_id": null. That breaks padding heuristics in our runtime.

ben: OK let's add a tokenizer override in the manifest so the ingest doesn't fail hard. Example snippet to include in manifest 
```json
{"tokenizer_override": {"pad_token_id": 50256}}
```
We should also open a quick CR to make sure we don't accidentally change other ids.

alice: CI just flagged shard-0002 checksum mismatch — the shard was uploaded with md5 in the metadata but our manifest expects sha256 digests. Ingest verifier prefers sha256: use sha256 in manifest, keep md5 as legacy if needed.

ingest-bot: ingest job 8342 start -> reading manifest at s3://models.redwood.com/hf/zeta-2.6b/manifest.json
status: partial
failed shards: shard-0002 (checksum mismatch)
repro: run `ingest-cli verify --manifest manifest.json` locally to reproduce the failure.

claire: I'll reupload shard-0002 with correct sha256 and update the manifest. Also can we get a quick code-review on the manifest change? @ben @alice — it's tiny.

ben: ack, give me a gander. I'll add a small unit test in the ingest-verifier that asserts tokenizer.pad_token_id is not null for newer models.

leo: ops update — granted read/write to ingest-service CI role for the models prefix. Added a lifecycle rule to expire staging mirrors after 30 days (won't apply to prod bucket).

qa-bot: Quick checklist
- presign TTL 24h :white_check_mark:
- sha256 in manifest :x: (pending upload)
- tokenizer.pad_token_id present :x: (pending manifest override)
- CI permission for ingest role :white_check_mark:

claire: Thanks all — reuploading shard-0002 now, will post new digest and updated manifest when complete :thumbsup:
